summary_en: eSOL announced a correction to its MBO disclosure dated September 1, 2026. The revision clarifies the nomenclature of shareholders agreeing to tender shares, adding temporal reference (September 1) to distinguish initial agreement holders from subsequently acquired commitments, including Abaale Data, a shareholder who agreed to tender all its shares on September 10.
title_en: Notice of Correction Regarding Partial Correction of the Notice on Implementation of MBO and Recommendation of Tendering
translation_en_brief:
eSOL Co., Ltd. issued a correction notice to its MBO-related disclosure dated September 1, 2026. The revision addresses nomenclature in Section 3(2), specifically clarifying references to agreeing shareholders. The company changed the terminology from "本応募合意株主" (agreeing shareholders) to "本応募合意株主（９月１日付）" (agreeing shareholders as of September 1) to distinguish initial commitment holders who signed agreements on September 1, 2026.

The initially identified shareholders totaling 1,678,854 shares (8.51% ownership) are: Masaki Gondo (CEO) committing 158,120 shares; Nobuyuki Kamiyama (director) committing 197,840 shares; Mitsunobu Yamada (former director) committing 520,120 shares; Katsutoshi Hasegawa (former CEO) committing 347,374 shares; Daisuke Sato (subsidiary director) committing 276,000 shares; and Kunihiko Tsuji (subsidiary director) committing 179,400 shares. Additionally, the correction introduces a new agreement holder: Abaale Data Co., Ltd., a shareholder who, following discussions initiated in late June 2026, agreed on September 10, 2026, to tender all its shares in the public offer. The revision clarifies the temporal sequence of commitments and expands the group of agreeing shareholders beyond the September 1 signatories.
